notes.title: New Mini-Games and Board Game Mode Update!
notes.notes:
New Features and Improvements

🎉 New Maps are here in our game! In this update, we’re bringing you two exciting new maps to spice up the gameplay

❄️ Icy Showdown: Try to stay on your feet as you dodge crabs thrown at you on a slippery surface!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/b398fcc10f2cd3460054459ddebec1a8e9c9687c.png
🏃‍♂️ Treadmill Tumble: Press the correct button within the given time to stay in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/6de0229c21e422d49174fd2d104272c0de051a00.png
🃏 Thief Card

A new strategic card that lets you steal a random card from a chosen player’s deck is now available!

💸 Bankruptcy Card

If your money drops below zero, this penalty card is added to your deck. It activates the second time you go below zero and sends you to jail!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/c49f8735c9944b728483fee44496b46def2d07a1.gif

🛍️ Membership Card

A passive card that applies a 70% discount  on your first purchase at the store is now in the game.

📊 Property Panel

Players’ property count, types, and plunder status can now be viewed when pressing the Tab key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/86b99971bdfd2c385a257aad5f9be53d60549848.png

🎮 Mini-Game Frequency

Added an option in the settings to adjust the frequency of mini-games in Board Game mode e.g., every 2 turns, every 3 turns. Additionally, the interface now displays how many turns remain until the next mini-game.

⏱️ Ready Mode Option

After mini-games, the game will not return to the board until a specified number of players mark themselves as ready.

🗂️ Mini-Game Selection List

Added the ability to select which mini-games can be played in Board Game mode from a list.

🏃‍♀️ Speed Settings

Added options to increase character speed to 1x, 2x, or 3x. The default speed has been set to 2x, which means character speed has increased by default.

⏳ Countdown and Sound Alerts

A countdown that grows and shrinks and plays a sound alert near the end of the timer in Board Game mode has been added.

🔧 Bug Fixes

♻️ Rewrite Card

Fixed a bug where the Rewrite card would prevent returning to the main target.

🎮Dive into Feather Party and explore the latest mini-games, strategic cards, and gameplay options.

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 👋 ! We've made a new update to  Feather Party  and further improved the Board Game mode by considering your feedback. Here are the  new features  waiting for you:

 Map and Game Improvements 
 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/ccfb53e38792027a6c44c56622e6f63adb4236fb.png 

 🗺️✨ We want cards to be used more frequently in the game. To achieve this, we added the ability to purchase multiple cards each time you visit the Card Shop in Board Game mode. Additionally, we created a setting that can be adjusted while creating the lobby. This way, depending on the setting you choose while setting up the lobby, it is now possible to purchase 3, 2, or 1 card each time you visit the shop.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/58a0ca11d0e674499fd8842a936779f4ba1165a8.png 
 In Board Game mode, all players could see the cards purchased from the shop. Again, based on your request, a new setting has been added that allows you to hide these cards from other players.

 Profile frames showing the loading status of all players have been added to the return screen from Mini-games in Board Game mode. This way, if one of the players is experiencing a connection issue, it will be easier for us to notice.

 A button has been assigned for the Map in Board Game mode. We noticed that sometimes players struggled to roll the dice after viewing the map. Thanks to this setting, there will no longer be any confusion during dice rolls, and the dice roll button will now remain fixed no matter what you did before :)

 The Board Game details panel in the Pause Menu has been improved.

 The drop rates of certain cards in Board Game have been updated.

 System optimizations have been made at the end of Mini-games in Board Game mode.

 Bug Fixes 

 🔧🐞 We found and fixed a minor bug that allowed players to use a card immediately after rolling the dice or when it wasn't their turn.

 A bug that allowed a setting in the lobby settings panel to still be controllable after exiting the panel has been fixed.

 A bug that caused the game to freeze if a player who won a bonus egg at the end of Board Game mode left the game has been fixed.

Try the new update now and enjoy the improved Board Game mode! 🎉🕹️

#FeatherParty #BoardGameMode #MiniUpdate

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello Feather Party players! 🎉

In this update, we've focused on addressing the issues you've encountered in the game by taking your feedback into consideration and improving the overall gaming experience. Here are the details: 🔧📝

Map and Game Improvements

 Enhanced transition screen after mini-games in Board Game Mode.
 Added and improved functionality for the "Space" key to automatically roll the dice when no panels are open, and the dice roll is available in Board Game Mode.
 Updated the egg purchase panel in Board Game Mode to have the selected item automatically set as the purchase button when an egg is available for purchase.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed the camera returning to the card owner before seeing the second teleported target in Board Game Mode ReWrite card
 Various improvements were made to the Board Game Mode black screen bug.
 Fixed a bug where the game would hang on the loading screen when returning to the main menu in the middle of Board Game Mode.
 Fixed an issue where the game mode could not be changed from within the Lobby after finishing the Board Game Mode and returning to the Lobby
 Fixed a bug that caused certain map-select cards to become unusable and be removed from the deck in Board Game Mode.
 Resolved issues with card descriptions not being readable in the deck.
 Localization fixes 
 Fixed an issue with the Shield card's turn counter being unaffected in games without mini-games in Board Game Mode.
 Resolved an issue where the Maps tab appeared at the end of a game in Board Game Mode without mini-games.
 Fixed a bug where lobby music continued playing when returning to the main menu.
 Corrected an issue where the main menu music sometimes failed to play after returning from the lobby.

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.11.7
notes.notes:
We're excited to share some exciting new features and improvements in our latest update! In "Track Race," we've introduced a rear-view camera for better maneuvering and a revamped player ranking display. For golf enthusiasts, "Mini-Golf" now includes three new courses. "Ball Fight" gets more dynamic with moving platforms, and we've made significant audio and visual enhancements across various modes. Additionally, "Host Migration" now has an exit button, offering more flexibility for players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/789a1365e4fb2203a2d75a674340b747965be672.png

We've also added a thrilling new feature in "Ball Fight," where platforms now move up and down dynamically after a certain period, making gameplay even more challenging and exciting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/dec0da79ceaeec85c38209294ca2d6e4f4d0ef04.gif

Check out the detailed notes below for a complete changelog:

New Features & Improvements

Mini-Golf: Added 3 new golf courses.
Ball Fight: Platforms now move up and down dynamically after a certain time during the game.
Ball Fight: Balancing adjustments.
Track Race: The player ranking list has been changed from a text box to a standard format with images and icons.
Track Race: Added a rear-view camera (hold C key) to switch to a fixed camera showing the rear view.
Track Race: Vehicle physics improvements (using the handbrake no longer slows the car) 
Track Race: Reduced the time for the camera to recenter.
Host Migration: Added a cancel button to Host Migration, allowing non-host players to leave during the loading screen.
Mini-Football: Increased speed of the Flaming Ball.
Mine Sweeper: Removed excessive flashing lights during color mixing to prevent epilepsy triggers.
Water Shader: Made some optimizations and visual changes.
Audio stops playing when the game is not in focus.
updated to turn off lights during mixing and reveal new colors afterward.
Added vehicle controls to the Keybinding section.
Audio stops playing when the game is not in focus.
Reduced saturation and vibrance of grass colors game-wide.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with character movement keys (forward, backward, left, right) not working in keybindings.
The game now ends automatically and awards XP correctly if the host is left alone after Host Migration.
Prevented non-host players from using the switch buttons between Private/Party modes in the lobby.

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.11.6
notes.notes:
Hello Feather Party players!

In this update, we focused on addressing the issues you've reported and improving the overall game experience based on your feedback. Here are the details:

 New Ball Physics System 
Ball physics was one of the top complaints we received, so we completely revamped the ball physics system! You can perform lofted and precise shots with the attack button, and make more powerful shots with the Dash button. Normal touches now provide a more minimal and controllable dribbling experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/20a7839846037d602b0c2622d650f20066955369.gif

Rainy and Sunny Weather Conditions
Now, rainy and sunny weather conditions will appear randomly in our games! You might even encounter thunderstorms occasionally. Currently available in Mini-Football, Cannon Island, and Spotlight maps. These dynamic weather changes will add new excitement to your gameplay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/1404f14bdb73e4bca521aecd49b1abe6dc553c84.gif

 Map and Game Improvements

Spotlight: We updated the game map with changes and visual enhancements to make gameplay easier.
Balloon Rush: We updated the game map to make gameplay easier.
Mini-Golf: We made updates to make gameplay easier on the maps. We added the Reset/Respawn function. You can now teleport to the Checkpoint area by pressing a button.
Feather Catch: The issue of losing feathers if you use Dash has been removed.
Lobby Management / Player Kick: We updated the Player Kick panel.
Lobby Settings: We added the "NEW" label above the newly added games listed in the lobby settings.
Game Logo: We added the early access text above the game logo.
Feedback Button: We updated the areas where the feedback button should and should not be visible.


 Bug Fixes

Track Race: The bug that allowed Nitro to be used while going in reverse has been fixed.
Falling Blocks: The issue of gliding outside the map and getting stuck in walls or climbing to an upper block has been fixed.


With this update, we aim to make your gaming experience smoother. Your feedback and responses are very valuable to us. Keep playing and keep sharing your fun!

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.11.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

With this update, we added a quick chat menu to the game. You can access this menu by pressing the R key and selecting the message you want to say to your teammates. We now have a quick, albeit very simple, chat tool via this interface with people we do not meet in a Discord channel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/8e9f797163979b16c6e21d2addf913376f10654b.png

Are there any message examples you would like to add to this menu? If you have it, you can send it to us directly under this post.

Apart from this update, we also made improvements to many titles and fixed some bugs. Let's briefly summarize them now:


 The player-level system has been balanced.

 Added region sorting for the browser. You can choose from 3 different options. You can filter it: Worldwide - Far - Close

 Improvements have been made to filters in the browser to show more accurate results.

 It has been fixed that people using CapsLock will see an unknown key as an image when assigning keys.

 Name and level display has been added to the pause screen so that players can easily see their levels.

 When the player list in the top left is expanded, it remains fixed and does not shrink again.

 The waiting time at the end of the maps of games played with Ready Mode has been reduced.

 The default target score in Party Mode has been changed to 15.

 An improvement has been made to ensure that the sounds do not decrease inconsistently when adjusting the sound levels in the settings.

 Fixed the control keys being displayed as different types of gamepads when playing with a gamepad.

 Fixed the icon of living people appearing dead on the scoreboard screen.

 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused players to fly up in Ball Fight mode.

 Fixed the bug that caused some users to be kicked out of the lobby in Ball Fight mode.

 Fixed the bug that caused users to get double points in Mini Golf mode.

 Fixed the issue where the texts at the bottom right giving the type information of the mini-games in the Lobby Settings window appear intertwined.

 Fixed the issue where assigned keys would be reset after assigning keys from the settings screen.

 Fixed issue where chicks entering the area immediately after the electricity visual disappears in Spotlight Mode would be electrocuted.

 Physics improvements have been made in Mini Football and Ice Hockey mode

notes.title: Release Notes v.0.0.10.2
notes.notes:
As we are very close to releasing Feather Party in early access, we continue to add new features to the game. Let's summarize them briefly:


 For players who don't want to quickly move on to the next game between mini-games, we've added a Ready mode. When you set up the game by turning this mode on, you can't move on to the next game until half of the people in the lobby say ready. In this way, you can take as much break as you want between games.
 A new level system has been added to the game. At the end of each game we play, we earn an experience point according to our stats in the game.
 We want to be able to include players who fall too far behind in the game in the points when they earn points again. For this reason, we have added a mechanic that can give a point bonus to those who are lower in the ranking in the game for a comeback.
 Many new faces have been added to the game, from extremely cute to very angry, from a little crazy to tearful faces.
 The visual theme of the Mini Golf game has been completely revamped.
 Rollerball has improved controls and added collision effects.
 Improved visuals in Mine Sweeper.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44087553/a9f7daa307ef2fe07931d6cbbe9aacea37e99773.png

Many improvements have also been made with this update. Let's list them now:


 Design changes have been made to the Speedrun section and dock area on Lobby Island.
 The end of the map ranking system has been revamped.
 The interface of the Lobby Settings panel has been revamped.
 Added a frame for the Level bar that shows the cosmetic item that will be unlocked when leveling up.
 Added arena shrinking over time in Ball Fight.
 Made visual adjustments to Shaky Tiles.
 Loading screen transition time has been shortened by over 50%.


And of course, we continued to fix many bugs, the most important of which you can see below:


 Fixed incorrect teleporting back to the lobby, stuck loading screen, and camera opening incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where the game would start twice as a result of a delayed load when transitioning into the game.
 Fixed an issue where other players would not appear after a delayed load when transitioning into the game.
 Fixed an issue where the character would spawn with a delay.
 Fixed an issue where the score frame would not appear due to the Return Score.
 Fixed an issue where the character could move at the end of the game in Ball Fight.
 Fixed a bug that would lock the loading screen if a player exits during scene changes.
